Assessment Builder
Every role deserves confident hiring
Create scientifically-validated, role-specific assessments in minutes. Bring science-backed hiring to all roles, because great talent isn’t limited to the top tier.
Request a demo
“We were so excited to learn about Assessment Builder—a product that will solve an actual problem we have. It’s easy to see the value a product like Assessment Builder can bring to our organisation.”
– Talent Acquisition Specialist
Multinational Banking and Financial Services Company
Strategy. Speed. Self-service.
Simple.
Hirevue’s Assessment Builder delivers PhD-level validation with self-service simplicity. Turn your job description into a scientifically-validated assessment in minutes. Replace subjective hiring signals with objective skill proof. Built on a trusted enterprise platform, grounded in decades of research and hundreds of validation studies, now every hire is backed by evidence, not perception.
Speed meets strategy
Strategic hiring shouldn’t mean lengthy hiring. Create role-specific, scientifically validated assessments in minutes. Assessment Builder brings PhD-level expertise to every hiring decision, empowering your team to deploy predictive, data-driven assessments at scale.
No bottlenecks. Just science-backed speed.
Decades of science right at your fingertips.
Every hire deserves a confident decision backed by data, even if it’s low volume or a role that has never used assessments. Get instant access to decades of IO research and fairness-validated frameworks. Assessment Builder identifies the right skills and assessments for every role, delivering high-level science and confidence at self-service speed.
Replace gut feeling with data-backed proof.
Back your decisions with data and science, and say goodbye to “gut instinct.” Validated assessments measure what actually predicts performance and not just what looks good on paper. Hire based on evidence, not assumptions – across your organisation.
Say goodbye to the resume
: Hire based on evidence instead of assumptions and gut-feel
Validate the skills that drive success
: Don’t just rely on self-reported or inferred skills. Make decisions with science built for validation.
Combine multiple validated measures
: Assess skills, cognitive abilities, and behaviours, all in one assessment experience

trust

Decades of research, market and O*Net data, hundreds of validation study results power the recommendations
Fairer, predictive hiring frameworks
IO-validated frameworks ensure every assessment is grounded in fairness and predictive validity.
Enterprise-tested assessments
Built on a trusted assessment platform used by global enterprises for years to improve quality of hire.
